input.body: We are writing to request a review of a deduction of $24.30 on order UE-9a31, dated 2026-11-05, which was applied with the reason "missing item" (Honey Drizzle). The order ticket for UE-9a31 lists 'Honey Drizzle' [UE-9a31:ticket_lists_item]. This shows the item was part of the order as it was placed with the kitchen. We recognise that the ticket alone does not show what was in the bag. Our records also show that the order was ready at 12:28 and was picked up at 12:33, 5 minutes later [UE-9a31:pickup_handoff]. The handoff to the courier therefore took place after the order was marked ready. Based on this information, we ask that the deduction be reviewed and, if the evidence supports it, reversed. Thank you for your time and consideration.
